verdict_text:
NO.

The `matrix_re` pattern omits `attn.c_proj.weight`, so only 36 of the 48 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and all 12 `h.<i>.attn.c_proj.weight` tensors are written as float32 — a violation of Required result clause 1. The guard that should catch this is itself wrong: it asserts `... == 36` instead of the specified 48, so the script fails silently rather than loudly, violating the first Required check ("exactly 48 tensors are bfloat16"). The other three checks (c_attn bfloat16, `wte.weight` float32, 148 tensors) are implemented correctly, and the buffer deletion and name preservation are correct. Sharding correctness cannot be confirmed from this file alone since it is delegated to the unshown `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, but the dtype defect alone means grading against the bit-exact reference will fail.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
